evidence.excerpt: It integrates dimensional analysis, structural causal models, Bayesian evidence computation, and multi-wavelength data fusion in a single automated workflow.

evidence.excerpt: In a direct comparison, agentic-LLM and pure-ML baselines match the statistical fitting but not the physics-validation stage.

evidence.excerpt: The main sequence and mass-metallicity relation are recovered, and the outlier detector, with a false-discovery-rate threshold and no contamination parameter, recovers the blind injected fraction on ten sealed datasets (purity > 0.99) and flags nothing on the 3,000-galaxy sample.
